question: Which of the following revolutionaries shot himself dead while fighting with the police at Alfred Park in Allahabad in 1931?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Chandrashekhar Azad.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chandrashekhar Azad** was a revolutionary freedom fighter who was a member of the **Hindustan Socialist Republican Association **(HSRA).
 
• He was known for his** bravery and fearlessness** in fighting against the British rule.
 
• Azad was born on **July 23, 1906,** in **Bhavra, Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• He died on **February 27, 1931**, at **Alfred Park** in **Allahabad** while fighting the police.
 
• Azad is remembered for his famous quote "**Dushman ki goliyon ka hum samna karenge, Azad hee rahein hain, Azad hee rahenge"** (We will face the bullets of the enemy, we are free and will remain free).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Khudiram Bose** was a revolutionary freedom fighter who was **executed** at the age of 18 for his involvement in the **Muzaffarpur conspiracy case.**
 
• **Rash Behari Bose** was a revolutionary who was involved in the Indian independence movement and played a key role in the Indian National Army.
 
 
• He had created the Indian Independence League and was one of the main organizers of the **Ghadar Mutiny. **
 
 
 
• **Ram Prasad Bismil** was a revolutionary who was involved in the** Kakori conspiracy case.**
 
 
• **​**He was a member of the **1918 Mainpuri Conspiracy.**
